# mode golden args... (run from the package folder)
# hand-computed cases: every word and every result was worked out on paper
exact tests/golden-cases.txt cases
# seeded differential runs against the reference model
exact tests/golden-fuzz-1.txt fuzz 1 20000
exact tests/golden-fuzz-7.txt fuzz 7 50000
# seeded property run, no model
exact tests/golden-props-1.txt props 1 20000
# every planted defect must be refused by both checks
exact tests/golden-controls.txt controls
# trap profile: hand-computed CSR, trap and MRET cases and the trap-handler program
exact tests/golden-mcases.txt mcases
# trap profile: seeded differential runs against the reference model, CSRs compared after every step
exact tests/golden-mfuzz-1.txt mfuzz 1 20000
exact tests/golden-mfuzz-7.txt mfuzz 7 50000
# trap profile: seeded property run, no model
exact tests/golden-mprops-1.txt mprops 1 20000
# trap profile: every planted defect must be refused by both checks
exact tests/golden-mcontrols.txt mcontrols
# timer and interrupts: hand-computed cases and the timer program, run twice with the state hash compared
exact tests/golden-icases.txt icases
# timer and interrupts: seeded differential runs with frequent interrupts, mtime and mtimecmp compared after every step
exact tests/golden-ifuzz-1.txt ifuzz 1 20000
exact tests/golden-ifuzz-7.txt ifuzz 7 50000
# timer and interrupts: seeded property run, no model
exact tests/golden-iprops-1.txt iprops 1 20000
# timer and interrupts: every planted defect must be refused by both checks
exact tests/golden-icontrols.txt icontrols
# flat images: hand-computed loader, start state, hash, compare and run cases
exact tests/golden-rcases.txt rcases
# flat images: seeded property run on random images, no model
exact tests/golden-rprops-1.txt rprops 1 20000
# flat images: every planted defect must be refused by the cases and by the property rules
exact tests/golden-rcontrols.txt rcontrols
# flat images: the built-in timer image as hex, and the committed file compared with it
exact tests/golden-image-timer.txt image timer
exact tests/golden-image-check.txt image timer tests/timer.img
# flat images: the timer image file run once, and run twice with the state hash compared every 1000 steps
exact tests/golden-run-timer.txt run tests/timer.img 10000
exact tests/golden-replay-timer.txt replay tests/timer.img 10000
# flat images: the same file in 65536 bytes of memory, long enough to empty the output buffer
exact tests/golden-replay-timer-64k.txt replay tests/timer.img 25000 65536
# flat images: a missing file, an empty file and a file larger than memory are refused
exact tests/golden-run-missing.txt run tests/no-such.img 10
exact tests/golden-run-empty.txt run tests/empty.img 10
exact tests/golden-run-large.txt run tests/golden-cases.txt 10
# M and A extensions: hand cases of every instruction; the words and the expected values come from tests/tools/ma_oracle.py
exact tests/golden-xcases.txt xcases
# M and A extensions: seeded differential runs of a stream weighted toward M and A words and edge operands
exact tests/golden-xfuzz-1.txt xfuzz 1 20000
exact tests/golden-xfuzz-7.txt xfuzz 7 50000
# M and A extensions: seeded property run, no model
exact tests/golden-xprops-1.txt xprops 1 20000
# M and A extensions: every planted defect must be refused by the differential check, the properties and the hand cases
exact tests/golden-xcontrols.txt xcontrols
# the program tests/mulatomic.s of asm-rv64 0.2.0 (MUL, DIV, REM and an LR/SC retry loop), from the committed image
exact tests/golden-run-mulatomic.txt run tests/mulatomic.img 100
exact tests/golden-replay-mulatomic.txt replay tests/mulatomic.img 100
exact tests/golden-replay-mulatomic-5000.txt replay tests/mulatomic.img 5000
